description: This file is a Perl module named DiffHighlight that provides functionality for highlighting diff outputs, specifically for use in visualizing code differences with color highlighting in terminal environments. It includes functions for handling diff hunks, line highlighting, and color configuration, indicating it is part of a diff visualization tool.

methods.name: visible_width
methods.description: Calculates the visible width of a string excluding terminal color sequences.

methods.name: visible_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring of the input string omitting a specified number of visible characters, ignoring color sequences.

methods.name: handle_line
methods.description: Processes a line of diff output, handling diff hunks, graph lines, and diff segments, and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the current diff hunks, displaying any queued removed and added lines.

methods.name: highlight_stdin
methods.description: Reads diff output from standard input and processes each line for highlighting.

methods.name: color_config
methods.description: Retrieves color configuration values from git config, with a fallback default.

methods.name: show_hunk
methods.description: Displays a diff hunk with appropriate highlighting for removed and added lines.

methods.name: highlight_pair
methods.description: Highlights differences between a pair of lines, identifying common prefixes and suffixes for emphasis.

methods.name: split_line
methods.description: Splits a diff line into segments, separating color sequences from regular characters.

methods.name: highlight_line
methods.description: Highlights a segment of a diff line based on specified theme colors.

methods.name: is_pair_interesting
methods.description: Determines if a pair of lines differs enough to warrant highlighting differences.
